newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid general index close revised up 0.18 points.
newsitem.headline: Madrid general index close revised up 0.18 points.

text.p: The Madrid stock market adjusted the level of its general index on Thursday after technical problems meant that movements in one stock were not included in the index in recent sessions.
Technical problems with the coding on Grupo Acciona meant that the general index was out by 0.18 points.
"The index close today of 603.69 points now includes Grupo Acciona," a spokesperson from the bourse said.
"A change in coding of the stock was not translated to the construction index nor the general index in the last few days," the bourse said.
As a result, Wednesday's close which was initially at a level of 601.73 should have been 601.91 points.
